grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link to your PAYE employment records

grants.description: Access your PAYE employment records held by HMRC
grants.purpose: To verify your employment and generate P45 information showing tax paid in the tax year

grants.description: Allow HMRC to contact your former employer on your behalf
grants.purpose: To verify with your employer that you have left employment and request P45 issuance if not already done

grants.description: Confirm employment details including employer name, dates, and reason for leaving
grants.purpose: To match against HMRC records and process your P45 request

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC or revoke through your personal tax account
revocation.effect: Request will be cancelled if consent is revoked before P45 information is issued. Already-issued P45 information cannot be withdrawn.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot contact your employer without explicit consent. Agent cannot dispute employment dates or tax calculations on your behalf. Agent cannot access records older than 4 years without human verification.
